$comment: Smoke set v0 (2026-10-15). Everyday trader/family sentences. The speaker's audio is synthesised by our own TTS (Piper te, Kokoro hi/en/zh), so ASR scores are OPTIMISTIC: real voices on phones will be worse. Phase 1 replaces this with recorded human speech. Fields: text = what is spoken; gloss = English meaning; numbers = values that must survive into the translation; negation = sentence contains a 'not'.

te.text: ఈ బియ్యం ధర కిలోకి యాభై రూపాయలు.
te.gloss: This rice costs 50 rupees per kilo.

te.text: మొత్తం రెండు వేల ఐదు వందల రూపాయలు అయింది.

te.gloss: I will not sell at this price.

te.text: నా ఫోన్ నంబర్ తొమ్మిది ఎనిమిది నాలుగు ఎనిమిది సున్నా రెండు రెండు మూడు మూడు ఎనిమిది.
సరుకు సోమవారం సాయంత్రం ఐదు గంటలకు వస్తుంది.
te.gloss: The goods arrive on Monday at 5 in the evening.

te.text: మీరు ముందుగా సగం డబ్బు పంపండి, మిగతాది డెలివరీ తర్వాత ఇవ్వండి.
te.gloss: Send half the money first, give the rest after delivery.

te.text: ఈ నెల పదిహేనో తేదీ లోపు డబ్బు చెల్లించాలి.
te.gloss: The money must be paid before the 15th of this month.
How many bags do you need?

te.text: నాకు ఆ రంగు నచ్చలేదు, వేరే రంగు చూపించండి.
te.gloss: I did not like that colour, show me another one.

en.text: Good morning, how is your family?
en.gloss: Good morning, how is your family?

en.gloss: The price is 500 rupees per kilo.

en.text: I need twenty bags of rice by Friday.
en.gloss: I need 20 bags of rice by Friday.

en.text: Please don't send the goods before the payment.
en.gloss: Please don't send the goods before the payment.

en.text: My number is nine eight seven six five four three two one zero.
The total comes to twelve thousand five hundred rupees.
I will not pay more than three hundred rupees.
en.gloss: I will not pay more than 300 rupees.

en.text: Can you deliver it tomorrow morning?
en.gloss: Can you deliver it tomorrow morning?

en.text: The meeting is at four o'clock in the afternoon.
en.gloss: The meeting is at 4 in the afternoon.

en.text: We have never had this problem before.
en.gloss: We have never had this problem before.

en.text: Send me two kilos of onions and one litre of oil.
en.gloss: Send me 2 kilos of onions and 1 litre of oil.

en.text: Thank you very much, see you next week.
en.gloss: Thank you very much, see you next week.

hi.text: इस चावल का दाम पचास रुपये किलो है।

hi.gloss: I will not sell at this price.

hi.text: मेरा नंबर नौ आठ चार आठ शून्य दो दो तीन तीन आठ है।
माल सोमवार शाम पाँच बजे पहुँचेगा।

hi.gloss: Send half the money first, give the rest after delivery.

zh.gloss: This rice is 50 yuan per kilo.

zh.text: 我的电话是一三八一二三四五六七八。
